# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

We are delighted to announce the successful completion and full overseas delivery of a new batch of
industrial steam autoclaves. This customized high-pressure autoclave equipment is specially
manufactured for our overseas clients engaged in new building material production. After rigorous
factory testing, precise commissioning and standardized packaging, the equipment has been fully
loaded and shipped overseas, which will be officially put into use in the customer’s AAC block and
environmental protection brick production line to support their factory capacity expansion and
standardized production upgrade. Shipment and Customization Details The shipped industrial autoclave
adopts standard pressure vessel manufacturing technology, tailored according to the customer’s
on-site workshop conditions, production output requirements and material curing processes. Optimized
for high-efficiency steam circulation and constant pressure curing, the equipment is perfectly
suitable for mass production of AAC aerated concrete blocks, autoclaved fly ash bricks, lime-sand
bricks and other autoclaved building materials. Different from conventional autoclave equipment,
this customized model upgrades the internal steam uniform distribution system and intelligent PLC
control module. It achieves stable and consistent temperature and pressure throughout the curing
process, effectively improving the compactness, structural strength and finished product
qualification rate of building materials, while reducing overall energy consumption and production
costs for end users. Strict Pre-Shipment Quality Inspection Quality assurance is the core of every

pressure calibration, as well as full debugging of safety interlock systems. All test indicators
fully meet international pressure vessel standards and overseas industrial production
specifications, ensuring long-term stable and safe operation of the equipment. To cope with
long-distance international sea transportation, we adopted professional integrated packaging and
fixing solutions. The autoclave body is treated with anti-rust, anti-corrosion and scratch-resistant
protection. Precision control components, sensors and electrical systems are equipped with
independent shockproof, moisture-proof and dust-proof packaging. Strict container fixing and binding
measures prevent equipment displacement and vibration damage during transportation, realizing intact
zero-defect delivery. Reliable Delivery and Global Service Support As a professional manufacturer of
building material curing autoclaves, we have complete standardized production processes and mature

quality control standards to ensure on-time and high-quality delivery for every overseas order. Our
industrial steam autoclaves are widely applicable in new building material production, aerated
concrete processing, cement product curing and other fields, and have been exported to Southeast
Asia, Africa, the Middle East and other global markets. We support personalized customization of
different diameters, lengths, working pressure and intelligent configurations, providing global
customers with one-stop solutions including equipment customization, production, installation,
commissioning and after-sales technical support. In the future, we will continue to focus on
optimizing autoclave equipment performance and production efficiency, providing more high-quality,
energy-saving and intelligent pressure vessel equipment for the global building material
manufacturing industry.

Gres yağ, metal yüzeyleri korumak ve aşınmayı önlemek için kullanılan bir yağlayıcıdır. Gres yağlar,
mineral yağ, sentetik yağ, sabun ve katı yağlayıcıların karışımından oluşur.

][61]
[

### Biyodizel Tesisleri

Biyodizel tesisleri, bitkisel ve hayvansal yağları yenilenebilir enerjiye diğer adıyla biyodizele
dönüştürmek için özel olarak tasarlanan tesislerdir.

][62]
[

### Antifriz Üretim Tesisleri

Antifriz üretim tesislerinin tasarımı, inşası ve devreye alınması karmaşık bir süreçtir. Aces
Process, projenin her aşamasını yönetir ve sorunsuz bir şekilde

][63]
[

### Renklendirme Tesisleri

Renklendirme tesisleri, birçok endüstride kullanılan pigmentlerin ve boyaların üretimini sağlar.
Aces Process olarak, renklendirme tesislerinin kurulumunda anahtar teslim hizmet veriyoruz.

][64]
[

### Evaporasyon Sistemleri

Evaporasyon, bir sıvının ısı etkisi ile buharlaştırılarak daha yoğun ve konsantre bir ürün elde etme
işlemi olarak tanımlanır.

][65]
[

### Distilasyon Sistem ve Üniteleri

Distilasyon damıtma sistemleri, karmaşık kimyasal karışımları ayrıştırmak ve saflaştırmak amacıyla
kullanılan temel bir kimyasal işlem yöntemidir.

][66]
[

### Alkid Üretim Tesisleri

Aces Process Şirketi, yılların deneyimi ve uzman kadrosu ile alkid reçine üretim tesislerinin
tasarımından montajına kadar her aşamada en yüksek kalitede hizmet sunar.

][67]
[

### Üre Formaldehit Tesisleri

Üre formaldehit tesislerinin kurulumunda, Aces Process'in gücü, bilgisi ve mükemmel mühendislik
yetenekleri öne çıkar.

][68]
[

### Petrokimya Tesisleri

Petrokimya tesisleri, ham petrolden elde edilen çeşitli kimyasal bileşenleri işleyen ve bu
bileşenlerden farklı kimyasal ürünler üreten endüstriyel tesislerdir.

][69]
[

### PVA Üretim Tesisi

PVA (Polivinil Asetat) üretim tesislerinde kullanılan başlıca makine ve ekipmanlar, bu kompleks
kimyasal sürecin gerektirdiği özel ihtiyaçları karşılamak üzere

][70]
[

### Hot Melt Tesisleri

Hot melt üretim tesisleri, endüstriyel yapıştırma ve ambalajlama uygulamaları için gerekli olan
sıcak eriyen yapıştırıcıların üretimine odaklanan özel tesislerdir.

][71]
[

### Poliüretan Köpük Tesisleri

Poliüretan Köpük Tesisleri : Poliüretan Sünger Fabrikaları. Poliüretan tesis kurulumu, karmaşık ve
özel gereksinimleri olan bir mühendislik sürecini içerir.

][72]
[

### Endüstriyel Tesis Kurulumu

Endüstriyel tesis kurulumu karmaşık ve zorlayıcı bir süreç olabilir. Aces Process, endüstriyel tesis
kurulum projelerinde anahtar teslim hizmetler veriyor.

][73]
[

### Gıda Üretim Tesisleri

Aces Process, gıda üretim tesisleri konusunda uzman ekibe sahiptir. Uzmanlarımız, projenizin her
aşamasında yanınızda olacak ve size en uygun çözümü sunacaktır.

][74]
[

### Polyester Reçine Tesisleri

Aces Process, polyester reçine tesisinizin kurulum aşamasında her adımda yanınızdadır. Uzman
ekibimiz, projenizin zamanında ve bütçenize uygun şekilde tamamlar.

][75]
[

### Plastifiyan Tesisleri

Plastifiyan tesisleri, PVC gibi polimerlerin esnekliğini ve işlenebilirliğini artırmak için
kullanılan plastifiyanların üretildiği ve işlendiği tesislerdir.

][76]
[

### Yapı Kimyasalları Tesisi

Yapı Kimyasalları, inşaat sektöründe dayanıklılığı artırır, çevresel etkilere karşı koruma sağlar ve
inşaat süreçlerini daha verimli hale getirir.

][77]

### Kimya Tesisleri

Kimya tesisleri, kimyasal üretim süreçlerinde kullanılan ekipman, makine ve tesislerin yer aldığı
kompleks yapılar olarak tanımlanabilir.

][78]
[

### Kozmetik Tesisleri

Kozmetik tesisleri, kremler, losyonlar, sabunlar, şampuanlar, rujlar ve parfümler gibi kozmetik

][79]
[

### Üretim Hattı Kurulumu

Üretim hattı, hammaddeleri iş gücü ve zaman optimizasyonu sağlayarak nihai ürüne dönüştüren,
birbirine bağlı bir dizi işlemden oluşan entegre sistemlerdir.

][80]
[

### Deterjan Üretim Tesisleri

Aces, yılların deneyimi ve uzman kadrosu ile deterjan üretim tesislerinin tasarımından montajına
kadar her aşamada en yüksek kalitede hizmet sunar.

][81]

Biyogaz tesisleri, organik atıkların anaerobik koşullarda bakteriler tarafından parçalanmasıyla elde

## HİZMETLER

[

### Konsept ve Tasarım Mühendisliği

fikrinden somut bir ürüne dönüşmesine kadar her aşamada yanınızdayız.

][50]
[

### Temel ve Detay Mühendislik

Aces Process, her projenin temel ve detay mühendislik gereksinimlerini karşılamak için kapsamlı bir
hizmet yelpazesi sunar.

][51]
[

### Mürekkep Üretim Tesisleri

Aces Process, mürekkep tesislerinin kurulumu konusunda kapsamlı bir uzmanlık sunmaktadır.

][52]
[

### Pilot Üretim Tesisleri

Pilot üretim tesisleri, yeni ürünlerin geliştirilmesi veya mevcut ürünlerin yeni üretim
yöntemleriyle üretilmesi için kullanılan küçük ölçekli tesislerdir.

adına mükemmel bir mühendislikle tasarlanır.

][54]
[

### Su Bazlı Boya Üretim Tesisleri

][55]
[

### Solvent Bazlı Boya Üretim Tesisleri

sağlar.

][56]
[

### Boya Üretim Tesisleri

Yenilikçi teknolojilerimiz ve uzman kadromuzla, müşterilerimize güvenilir boyaları üretmeleri için
modern üretim tesisleri kuruyoruz.

][57]
[

### Vernik Üretim Tesisleri

kaplama malzemesidir.

][58]
[

### Tiner Üretim Tesisleri

tiner türlerinin üretildiği tesislerdir.

][59]
[

### Madeni Yağ Tesisleri

amacıyla tasarlanmış ve çeşitli katkı maddeleri ile zenginleştirilmiş endüstriyel yağların
üretildiği fabrikalardır.

][60]
[

mineral yağ, sentetik yağ, sabun ve katı yağlayıcıların karışımından oluşur.

][61]
[

### Biyodizel Tesisleri

Biyodizel tesisleri, bitkisel ve hayvansal yağları yenilenebilir enerjiye diğer adıyla biyodizele
dönüştürmek için özel olarak tasarlanan tesislerdir.

][62]
[

### Antifriz Üretim Tesisleri

Antifriz üretim tesislerinin tasarımı, inşası ve devreye alınması karmaşık bir süreçtir. Aces
Process, projenin her aşamasını yönetir ve sorunsuz bir şekilde

][63]
[

### Renklendirme Tesisleri

Renklendirme tesisleri, birçok endüstride kullanılan pigmentlerin ve boyaların üretimini sağlar.
Aces Process olarak, renklendirme tesislerinin kurulumunda anahtar teslim hizmet veriyoruz.

][64]
[

### Evaporasyon Sistemleri

Evaporasyon, bir sıvının ısı etkisi ile buharlaştırılarak daha yoğun ve konsantre bir ürün elde etme
işlemi olarak tanımlanır.

][65]
[

### Distilasyon Sistem ve Üniteleri

Distilasyon damıtma sistemleri, karmaşık kimyasal karışımları ayrıştırmak ve saflaştırmak amacıyla
kullanılan temel bir kimyasal işlem yöntemidir.

][66]
[

### Alkid Üretim Tesisleri

Aces Process Şirketi, yılların deneyimi ve uzman kadrosu ile alkid reçine üretim tesislerinin
tasarımından montajına kadar her aşamada en yüksek kalitede hizmet sunar.

][67]
[

### Üre Formaldehit Tesisleri

Üre formaldehit tesislerinin kurulumunda, Aces Process'in gücü, bilgisi ve mükemmel mühendislik
yetenekleri öne çıkar.

][68]
[

### Petrokimya Tesisleri

Petrokimya tesisleri, ham petrolden elde edilen çeşitli kimyasal bileşenleri işleyen ve bu
bileşenlerden farklı kimyasal ürünler üreten endüstriyel tesislerdir.

][69]
[

### PVA Üretim Tesisi

PVA (Polivinil Asetat) üretim tesislerinde kullanılan başlıca makine ve ekipmanlar, bu kompleks
kimyasal sürecin gerektirdiği özel ihtiyaçları karşılamak üzere

][70]
[

### Hot Melt Tesisleri

Hot melt üretim tesisleri, endüstriyel yapıştırma ve ambalajlama uygulamaları için gerekli olan
sıcak eriyen yapıştırıcıların üretimine odaklanan özel tesislerdir.

][71]
[

### Poliüretan Köpük Tesisleri

Poliüretan Köpük Tesisleri : Poliüretan Sünger Fabrikaları. Poliüretan tesis kurulumu, karmaşık ve
özel gereksinimleri olan bir mühendislik sürecini içerir.

][72]
[

### Endüstriyel Tesis Kurulumu

Endüstriyel tesis kurulumu karmaşık ve zorlayıcı bir süreç olabilir. Aces Process, endüstriyel tesis
kurulum projelerinde anahtar teslim hizmetler veriyor.

][73]
[

### Gıda Üretim Tesisleri

Aces Process, gıda üretim tesisleri konusunda uzman ekibe sahiptir. Uzmanlarımız, projenizin her
aşamasında yanınızda olacak ve size en uygun çözümü sunacaktır.

][74]
[

### Polyester Reçine Tesisleri

Aces Process, polyester reçine tesisinizin kurulum aşamasında her adımda yanınızdadır. Uzman
ekibimiz, projenizin zamanında ve bütçenize uygun şekilde tamamlar.

][75]
[

### Plastifiyan Tesisleri

Plastifiyan tesisleri, PVC gibi polimerlerin esnekliğini ve işlenebilirliğini artırmak için
kullanılan plastifiyanların üretildiği ve işlendiği tesislerdir.

][76]
[

### Yapı Kimyasalları Tesisi

Yapı Kimyasalları, inşaat sektöründe dayanıklılığı artırır, çevresel etkilere karşı koruma sağlar ve
inşaat süreçlerini daha verimli hale getirir.

][77]
[

### Kimya Tesisleri

Kimya tesisleri, kimyasal üretim süreçlerinde kullanılan ekipman, makine ve tesislerin yer aldığı
kompleks yapılar olarak tanımlanabilir.

][78]
[

### Kozmetik Tesisleri

Kozmetik tesisleri, kremler, losyonlar, sabunlar, şampuanlar, rujlar ve parfümler gibi kozmetik
ürünlerin üretildiği ve işlendiği endüstriyel tesislerdir.

[

### Üretim Hattı Kurulumu

Üretim hattı, hammaddeleri iş gücü ve zaman optimizasyonu sağlayarak nihai ürüne dönüştüren,
birbirine bağlı bir dizi işlemden oluşan entegre sistemlerdir.

Aces, yılların deneyimi ve uzman kadrosu ile deterjan üretim tesislerinin tasarımından montajına
kadar her aşamada en yüksek kalitede hizmet sunar.

[

### Biyogaz Tesisleri

Biyogaz tesisleri, organik atıkların anaerobik koşullarda bakteriler tarafından parçalanmasıyla elde
edilen biyogazın enerjiye dönüştürüldüğü tesislerdir.

## What Makes Advanced Engineering an unmissable event for the engineering and manufacturing
## industry?

Advanced Engineering sits at the heart of the UK’s industrial calendar – a two-day event at the NEC
Birmingham where the engineering and manufacturing community comes together to do business, share
knowledge and shape the direction of their sectors.

As one of the most significant engineering exhibitions UK has to offer, it brings thousands of
professionals together across aerospace, automotive, space, rail, maritime, energy and electronics –
where ideas move across disciplines, creating connections that a single-sector event cannot
replicate.

Registration for Advanced Engineering 2026 is free and open to all qualified professionals. Secure
your place now.

## What you will experience
* AI, Automation and Digitalisation See where robotics and automation genuinely pay back in

* Next-generation machinery Explore what the latest machine tools, hybrid systems and additive

* Reliability, safety and obsolescence Keep critical assets running safely and reliably while you

## Who visits Advanced Engineering?

## Who you will Network With
* Senior decision-makers Head and engineering leads, plan manager and senior manufacturing engineers

* Technology providers Machine tool suppliers, automation brands, system integrators, metrology and
  quality specialists and more.

### Is this event right for you?

# Connecting a broad range of engineering communities

### Quality and Testing Specialists

Discover new equipment, methods and data tools that reduce the time needed for validation and
sign-off without compromising standards.

### Electrical and Electronics Engineers

Learn how electronics is being integrated into vehicles, aircraft, machinery and infrastructure,
from early architecture decisions through to system-level testing.

## Materials Specialists

Discuss real-world trade-offs with engineers who have introduced new materials into certified,
safety-critical and high-performance products.

### Design Engineers

Learn from case studies showing how others have balanced performance, cost, weight and
sustainability in real projects.

### Procurement and Buyers

Understand how new technologies, regulations and sustainability requirements will affect your supply
chain and future sourcing decisions.

### Engineering and Manufacturing Leaders

See how leading organisations are cutting emissions, accelerating digitalisation and strengthening
their engineering supply chains.

* Engineering manager or chief engineer

* Continuous improvement manager
* Operations director

* Machine builder, OEM or integrator lead

* CNC machine tools & forming equipment
* Industrial robotics & automation systems
* Additive & hybrid manufacturing
* Tooling, workholding & fixturing
* Metrology, test & quality control
* Maintenance technologies & condition monitoring
* Safety systems & controls
* Materials & process technologies

## What Makes Advanced Engineering an unmissable event for the engineering and manufacturing
## industry?

Advanced Engineering sits at the heart of the UK’s industrial calendar – a two-day event at the NEC
Birmingham where the engineering and manufacturing community comes together to do business, share
knowledge and shape the direction of their sectors.

As one of the most significant engineering exhibitions UK has to offer, it brings thousands of
professionals together across aerospace, automotive, space, rail, maritime, energy and electronics –
where ideas move across disciplines, creating connections that a single-sector event cannot
replicate.

Registration for Advanced Engineering 2026 is free and open to all qualified professionals. Secure
your place now.

## Why attend Advanced Engineering?

## What you will experience
* AI, Automation and Digitalisation See where robotics and automation genuinely pay back in
  factories like yours, and how to introduce them without disrupting day‑to‑day production.
* Next-generation machinery Explore what the latest machine tools, hybrid systems and additive
  processes can do for your parts, costs and lead times
* Reliability, safety and obsolescence Keep critical assets running safely and reliably while you
  tackle ageing equipment, obsolescence and compliance.

Free entry. 400+ exhibitors, 6 CPD forums, live demos and networking lounges – all in one place.

## Who visits Advanced Engineering?

## Who you will Network With
* Senior decision-makers Head and engineering leads, plan manager and senior manufacturing engineers
  from aerospace, automotive, defence, space, rail and more.
* Technology providers Machine tool suppliers, automation brands, system integrators, metrology and
  quality specialists and more.
* Innovation ecosystem Innovation centres, catapults, universities and regional manufacturing
  programmes.

[ REGISTER NOW ][155]

### Is this event right for you?

# Connecting a broad range of engineering communities

### Quality and Testing Specialists

Discover new equipment, methods and data tools that reduce the time needed for validation and
sign-off without compromising standards.

### Electrical and Electronics Engineers

Learn how electronics is being integrated into vehicles, aircraft, machinery and infrastructure,
from early architecture decisions through to system-level testing.

## Materials Specialists

Discuss real-world trade-offs with engineers who have introduced new materials into certified,
safety-critical and high-performance products.

### Design Engineers

Learn from case studies showing how others have balanced performance, cost, weight and
sustainability in real projects.

### Procurement and Buyers

Understand how new technologies, regulations and sustainability requirements will affect your supply
chain and future sourcing decisions.

### Engineering and Manufacturing Leaders

See how leading organisations are cutting emissions, accelerating digitalisation and strengthening
their engineering supply chains.

## Who should visit Advanced Engineering?
* Director of engineering / manufacturing / operations
* Head of manufacturing or production
* Plant manager or site leader
* Engineering manager or chief engineer
* Senior manufacturing / production / process engineer
* Continuous improvement manager
* Operations director
* Managing director or owner (manufacturing SME)
* Machine builder, OEM or integrator lead

Free entry. 400+ exhibitors, 6 CPD forums, live demos and networking lounges – all in one venue.

## What solutions will you discover?

Explore hundreds of exhibitors showcasing the latest machinery, automation, tooling and production
technologies, including:
* CNC machine tools & forming equipment
* Industrial robotics & automation systems
* Additive & hybrid manufacturing
* Tooling, workholding & fixturing
* Metrology, test & quality control
* Maintenance technologies & condition monitoring
* Safety systems & controls
* Materials & process technologies

# Peace Of Mind

## Let us take care of your equipment servicing needs

We strive to be the service provider of choice in the dental and infection control industries in the
Canterbury region

### Call Us Today on 03 377 4793

## Who Are We?

Advanced Technical Services Ltd (ATS) is a Canterbury based service company established by Phillip
Ruby to meet the service requirements of dental practices. Our services have grown and we now also
offer our services medical practices (GP’s), orthodontic practices, oral surgeons, dental
laboratories, dental technicians and many more allied health care providers. ATS service most makes
and models of equipment including the following: Dental units, X-ray equipment; (film and digital
based systems), autoclaves, steam sterilisers, air compressors (oil free and silent), suction units,
and dental hand pieces (high speed and slow speed).

## Why Choose Us!

We believe in providing peace of mind for the people we engage and interact with

### Upfront Pricing

For common jobs we operate on a fixed pricing plan. For unpredictable work or repairs we will advise
you of all the options and prices before
carrying out the work

### Continuous Improvement

We are continually challenging the statis quo, and asking ourselves how we can improve the way we
service dental equipment

### Qualified Experts

We have over 30+ years experience in our team in the dental industry


##### What can we help you with?

Annual Servicing, Repairs and Validation of your Autoclave
Installation and maintenance of your suction unit & Air compressor
Installation, service, and repairs of your chair
Electrical Safety Testing to AS/NZS 3551 or 3760
Radiation safety testing to ORS C4

## Meet The Team

“My role is somewhat dynamic here at Advanced Tech, I run the company assisted by a fantastic team,
enjoy doing onsite work and meeting and liaising with our clients to ensure their equipment runs
flawlessly.”

something. On the flip side I also enjoy upgrading our internal processes and trying to make the
process easier”.

our clients by confirming their vital equipment is working correctly, and leaving it in a better
state than I found it”

IT ASSET MANAGEMENT SOFTWARE (ITAM)

# Smart IT Asset Management. Made Simple.

Track hardware, manage licenses, and automate employee handovers. Stop wasting time on messy
spreadsheets.

[Get started free→ ][15] [See pricing][16]

No credit card required · Free plan available · Setup in minutes

QR labels Checkouts & returns Service desk Approval flows
[Laptop mockup showing the AMPthilly dashboard with asset overview and navigation]

The problem

## Assets disappear when the process lives in spreadsheets, chat, and memory

Most companies own more than they can confidently track. AMPthilly gives every item a record, every
handover a history, and every employee a clear path to report issues or return what belongs to the
company.

### Ghost assets & lost devices

Equipment, keys, and devices move constantly between employees, tenants, and locations. Without a
central record, accountability disappears instantly.

### Outdated spreadsheets

A static spreadsheet shows what you bought, but rarely who has it right now, what condition it's in,
or when it's due back.

### Hidden replacement costs

Missing laptops, tools, keys, and monitors create unexpected expenses. Small, unbacked losses
quickly turn into massive annual costs.

### Fragmented service history

When service notes, key handovers, and issue reports live in messy emails or chats, nobody knows the
true history of the asset.

### Still tracking assets in a spreadsheet?

Start with the assets you lose track of most often, then expand the process as your team gets
comfortable.

[Start free][17] [Talk to sales][18]

How it works

## A simple workflow for the full asset lifecycle

AMPthilly is not just a list of equipment. It connects ownership, location, service, approvals,
returns, and financial context around the asset itself.

01

### Register the asset

Create a profile for physical or digital assets with serials, purchase details, warranty dates,
documents, and custom fields.

02

### Assign responsibility

Check assets out to employees, clients, departments, or locations so ownership is visible before
something goes missing.

03

### Label and scan

Generate QR labels, attach them to items, and scan with any smartphone camera to open the asset
record instantly.

04

### Report, approve, return

Employees can report issues, managers can approve requests, and teams can confirm returns with a
clear history.

[Start tracking free][19] [See all features][20]

What you get

## Everything you need to stay accountable

Built for companies that want fewer missing items, clearer responsibility, and less time spent
digging through spreadsheets.

[

### Asset register

Keep physical and digital assets in one place, from laptops, tools and keys to software licenses and
serial numbers.

Learn more → ][21][

### Checkouts and returns

Assign assets to employees or clients, track who is responsible, and make returns easier to follow
up.

Learn more → ][22][

### QR code labels

Generate labels for assets so teams can scan an item, open its profile, and see the details that
matter.

Learn more → ][23][

### Service desk

Let employees report issues with an asset and keep service requests, notes, and repair history
connected.

Learn more → ][24][

### Departments and approvals

Organise people by department, set clear responsibilities, and route requests through the right
approvers.

Learn more → ][25][

### Maintenance and financials

Track maintenance, purchase details, warranty dates, devaluation, and the full history behind every
asset.

Learn more → ][26]

### See how AMPthilly fits your company

Offices, contractors, workshops, schools, and field teams all need the same thing: clear ownership
and a record they can trust.

[Explore use cases][27] [Plan a rollout][28]

Product depth

## Built for more than a static inventory list

A serious asset system should cover the information around the asset: who owns it, where it is, what
it cost, what happened to it, and what needs attention next.

[

### Physical assets

Track laptops, screens, phones, tablets, vehicles, tools, machinery, keys, safety gear, and shared
equipment.

Learn more on Features → ][29]
[

### Digital assets

Keep software licenses, serial keys, subscriptions, assigned seats, renewal dates, and vendor
details in the same system.

Learn more on Features → ][30]
[

### Asset lifecycle

Follow each item from purchase and assignment through service, devaluation, replacement, return, or
retirement.

Learn more on Features → ][31]
[

### Search and filters

Find assets by owner, department, location, category, status, serial number, or the details your
team depends on.

Learn more on Features → ][32]

## One platform for the assets every team depends on

[Explore use cases→ ][35]

### Offices and IT teams

Manage laptops, screens, phones, software licenses, access cards, and keys during onboarding,
offboarding, and replacements.

### Electricians and contractors

Assign tools, vehicles, kits, and job equipment to people or client projects, then confirm what came
back.

### Workshops and operations

Track machinery, safety gear, repair history, inspections, and equipment that moves between
locations or teams.

### Schools and organisations

Keep shared devices, teaching equipment, keys, and borrowed materials visible across departments and
staff.

Inside AMPthilly

## Every asset gets a profile your team can actually use

Replace scattered notes with one place for assignments, QR labels, service tickets, maintenance,
documents, purchase details, and the next action.

Animated product preview of the AMPthilly dashboard: asset register, checkouts, QR labels, and
service desk in one interface. For a full walkthrough, see the [Features page][36].

Service desk and approvals

## Give employees a clear path when something breaks, moves, or needs approval

Asset tracking becomes more useful when employees can act on the record. Report damage, request
equipment, approve handovers, and keep maintenance history attached to the right item.

Instead of routing questions through chat threads, give people a single place to see status, who is
accountable, and what happens next. Managers keep visibility without becoming a bottleneck for every
small update.

When approvals and service notes live on the asset itself, audits and handovers take minutes instead
of detective work across inboxes and spreadsheets.

Employee reports an issue

An easy-to-use service desk where employees report a problem with a description and photos - without
guessing who to contact - and get help faster.

Responsible person reviews it

Managers, service teams, or department owners can see context, approve requests, and update the
status.

The asset history stays complete

Future decisions can include service notes, return condition, maintenance, purchase data, and
previous assignments.

### Want to map this to your approval process?

Bring your departments, managers, and asset types. We can help shape the right structure before
launch.

[Talk to sales][37]

Accountability built in

## Clear controls for how assets move through your company

When an asset moves, the record should move with it: visible responsibility, a trail you can follow
later, and exports when finance or another system needs the same picture.

### Role-based access

Separate views for admins, managers, employees, and service teams so people see the actions and
records that match their job.

### Audit-ready history

A chronological trail for assignments, returns, service updates, and asset edits so decisions are
easier to defend later.

### CSV in and out

Import from spreadsheets to get started, and export when you need backups, finance handoffs, or a
migration path.

### Privacy-conscious defaults

Company and employee data is treated with care - aligned with GDPR expectations for registers that
include people and locations.

FAQ

## Questions companies ask before they start tracking assets properly

### Can AMPthilly track both physical and digital assets?

Yes. AMPthilly is designed for equipment like laptops, tools, keys, vehicles, and screens, as well
as digital records like software licenses, serial keys, subscriptions, and renewal dates.

### Do QR labels require a special scanner?

No. Generate printable QR labels from any asset profile, attach them to equipment, and scan with a
regular phone camera to open the record and start the right action - such as reporting an issue or
checking who has the item.

### Can employees report issues with an item?

Yes. Employees use the built-in service desk to report problems with a description, photos, and
category. Tickets stay linked to the asset (or stand alone when needed), and managers update status
until the work is done.

### Can we migrate from spreadsheets?

Yes. CSV import helps you bring an existing list across, and export gives you a snapshot when
finance or another tool needs the same data.

### Is AMPthilly only for IT teams?

No. IT teams are a strong use case, but AMPthilly is meant for any company that needs better control
of physical or digital assets.

### Is the product ready for different company sizes?

AMPthilly is built to start simple and grow with more departments, roles, approvals, service
workflows, and asset volume as the process matures.

## Ready to stop losing track?

Build a cleaner record of every asset your company owns, assigns, services, and returns, before more
equipment disappears into old spreadsheets and memory.

The problem

## Assets disappear when the process lives in spreadsheets, chat, and memory

Most companies own more than they can confidently track. AMPthilly gives every item a record, every
handover a history, and every employee a clear path to report issues or return what belongs to the
company.

### Ghost assets & lost devices

Equipment, keys, and devices move constantly between employees, tenants, and locations. Without a
central record, accountability disappears instantly.

### Outdated spreadsheets

A static spreadsheet shows what you bought, but rarely who has it right now, what condition it's in,
or when it's due back.

### Hidden replacement costs

Missing laptops, tools, keys, and monitors create unexpected expenses. Small, unbacked losses
quickly turn into massive annual costs.

### Fragmented service history

When service notes, key handovers, and issue reports live in messy emails or chats, nobody knows the
true history of the asset.

### Still tracking assets in a spreadsheet?

Start with the assets you lose track of most often, then expand the process as your team gets
comfortable.

[Start free][17] [Talk to sales][18]

How it works

## A simple workflow for the full asset lifecycle

AMPthilly is not just a list of equipment. It connects ownership, location, service, approvals,
returns, and financial context around the asset itself.

01

### Register the asset

Create a profile for physical or digital assets with serials, purchase details, warranty dates,
documents, and custom fields.

something goes missing.

03

### Label and scan

Generate QR labels, attach them to items, and scan with any smartphone camera to open the asset
record instantly.

04

### Report, approve, return

Employees can report issues, managers can approve requests, and teams can confirm returns with a
clear history.

Whether your assets sit in an office, move between job sites, stay assigned to people, or renew as
digital subscriptions, the same record keeps ownership and history visible.

[Explore use cases→ ][35]

### Offices and IT teams

offboarding, and replacements.

### Electricians and contractors

back.

### Workshops and operations

Track machinery, safety gear, repair history, inspections, and equipment that moves between
locations or teams.

### Schools and organisations

Keep shared devices, teaching equipment, keys, and borrowed materials visible across departments and
staff.

Inside AMPthilly

## Every asset gets a profile your team can actually use

Replace scattered notes with one place for assignments, QR labels, service tickets, maintenance,
documents, purchase details, and the next action.

Animated product preview of the AMPthilly dashboard: asset register, checkouts, QR labels, and
service desk in one interface. For a full walkthrough, see the [Features page][36].

Service desk and approvals

## Give employees a clear path when something breaks, moves, or needs approval

Asset tracking becomes more useful when employees can act on the record. Report damage, request
equipment, approve handovers, and keep maintenance history attached to the right item.

Instead of routing questions through chat threads, give people a single place to see status, who is
accountable, and what happens next. Managers keep visibility without becoming a bottleneck for every
small update.

When approvals and service notes live on the asset itself, audits and handovers take minutes instead
of detective work across inboxes and spreadsheets.

Employee reports an issue

An easy-to-use service desk where employees report a problem with a description and photos - without
guessing who to contact - and get help faster.

Responsible person reviews it

Managers, service teams, or department owners can see context, approve requests, and update the
status.

The asset history stays complete

Future decisions can include service notes, return condition, maintenance, purchase data, and
previous assignments.

### Want to map this to your approval process?

Bring your departments, managers, and asset types. We can help shape the right structure before
launch.

[Talk to sales][37]

Accountability built in

## Clear controls for how assets move through your company

When an asset moves, the record should move with it: visible responsibility, a trail you can follow
later, and exports when finance or another system needs the same picture.

### Role-based access

Separate views for admins, managers, employees, and service teams so people see the actions and
records that match their job.

### Audit-ready history

A chronological trail for assignments, returns, service updates, and asset edits so decisions are
easier to defend later.

### CSV in and out

Import from spreadsheets to get started, and export when you need backups, finance handoffs, or a
migration path.

### Privacy-conscious defaults

Company and employee data is treated with care - aligned with GDPR expectations for registers that
include people and locations.

FAQ

## Questions companies ask before they start tracking assets properly

### Can AMPthilly track both physical and digital assets?

Yes. AMPthilly is designed for equipment like laptops, tools, keys, vehicles, and screens, as well
as digital records like software licenses, serial keys, subscriptions, and renewal dates.

### Do QR labels require a special scanner?

No. Generate printable QR labels from any asset profile, attach them to equipment, and scan with a
regular phone camera to open the record and start the right action - such as reporting an issue or
checking who has the item.

### Can employees report issues with an item?

Yes. Employees use the built-in service desk to report problems with a description, photos, and
category. Tickets stay linked to the asset (or stand alone when needed), and managers update status
until the work is done.

### Can we migrate from spreadsheets?

Yes. CSV import helps you bring an existing list across, and export gives you a snapshot when
finance or another tool needs the same data.

### Is AMPthilly only for IT teams?

No. IT teams are a strong use case, but AMPthilly is meant for any company that needs better control
of physical or digital assets.

### Is the product ready for different company sizes?

AMPthilly is built to start simple and grow with more departments, roles, approvals, service
workflows, and asset volume as the process matures.

## Ready to stop losing track?

Build a cleaner record of every asset your company owns, assigns, services, and returns, before more
equipment disappears into old spreadsheets and memory.

From compact vertical portable autoclaves to large horizontal autoclaves, ETO sterilizers, and full
CSSD turnkey setups — the widest range available from a single manufacturer in India.

states, with installation, AMC contracts, and dedicated after-sales service.

Our autoclaves and sterilizers are built with premium-grade stainless steel at our fully equipped
Mumbai facility, ensuring long service life, smooth finish, and superior build quality.

We offer Annual Maintenance Contracts, installation support, and prompt service response to ensure
your sterilization equipment performs reliably at all times.

## [AUTOCLAVE CONE AND THREADING][1]

Rig-Tech rents Autoclave cone and threading machines and we also provide world class Autoclave
installation services. These Autoclave machines have the ability to cone on one side and thread on
the other this machine makes easy work of large jobs or jobs using larger size tubing which cannot
be coned and threaded by hand. Autoclave coning and threading machine used for medium and high
pressure tubing end preparation. Our Autoclave installers are professional instrument fitters. call
713-481-2543. Visit us at
[http://rig-tech.us/tools/autoclave-cone-and-threading-machines-tools-fittings][2]

best performance and durability. The nut and ferrule safety changer will allow you to replace the

larger size tubing which cannot be coned and threaded by hand. Autoclave coning and threading
machine used for medium and [high pressure tubing ][55]end preparation.

simultaneously this machine provides superior production results.
